page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Below the text: a large initial "L" at centre-left and the catchword "CAPUT" at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: actione[?], atque absolutione illius ipsi menti, ma-
nu imperanti, illiusque ductus moderanti. De-
nique, si Scepticorum effata valere debeant,
artes, quarum ingens numerus vix ad digitos
revocari potest, servient magis turbandae huic
nostrae vitae, quam eidem perficiendae. At quis
hoc in animum suum induxerit? Consequentia
ex eo patet: quod omnibus artibus, quae prae-
supponunt in artifice definitam cognitionem ob-
jecti tum extrinseci, tum intrinseci (uti loquuntur)
dubiae, fallacesque esse debeant, magisque ser-
vire excarnificandae menti, vitaeque quae ab
e-adem ordinatur regiturque, quam perficiendae:
Verbi caussa enim, quam voluptatem sutor, ho-
minum pedibus muniendis adversus sexcentas
iniurias vacans, percipiet ex suo labore & ope-
re, si dubitare debeat, an illud circa quod oc-
cupatur corium, papyrus, arboris folium, aut
quid simile alterius rei sit? Item, an quod absolvit
opus, capiti magis, an pedi vestiendo servire ap-
tum sit? Atqui sic tamen illius mens oberrare
debet, & fluctuationum variarum aestibus iac-
tari, si quam fidem Pyrrhonij mereantur.

page.notes: The first word is a fragment at the page top; its first letter is uncertain (read as "a" in "actione"). The large "L" and "CAPUT" at the foot: "CAPUT" is taken as catchword, "L" as signature, both uncertain. Long s is rendered as plain s; the printed "fuum" is read as "suum". The page number "161" is printed in the top right corner. The faint text in the bottom right corner is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
